title: Bring this address to this account?
words: The account you just made with it holds nothing but a seat. Its seat in Acme moves to this account. It's deleted, and the address is verified for Acme on this account. The address never signs you in: keep signing in as you do now.
doneWords: The address is verified on this account now. The account made with it is deleted, and any seat it held is here.
